# Niural AI

Niural AI is a Financial Services company. Niural is an AI-powered platform that simplifies HR, payroll, compliance, hiring, and payments with a range of products and solutions. Niural AI employs 170 people (+65.0% YoY, +67 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with an office in San Francisco. Its workforce is distributed across 7 countries (including Nepal, United States, India, Argentina, and Canada).

## About

One platform that pays you back, thinks ahead and grows with you.
US payroll, PEO, ASO, EOR, global payroll and contractors, all on one employee record. Start with what you need now and add the rest when you need it.

Cash back
-Prefunded payroll held in Niural Wallet can earn cash rewards in the days before pay date.

AI-native
- EMMA catches payroll, benefits and compliance issues across every employment model and prepares the fix for your approval.

Grows with you
- From Payroll, add a PEO, move to ASO, without leaving the employee record. What's more, you can add global employees via EOR or contractors with a click.
